name: Taylor
goal: Taylor hopes to find a restaurant that serves food which aligns with their taste preferences and allows them to have a filling meal without unnecessary fuss.
backstory: Taylor has been craving something spicy all day and recalls a disappointing experience at a bland Italian restaurant last week. They prefer eating at places that serve bold flavors, like the Korean BBQ spot they visited on their birthday. Having tried a few new restaurants recently, Taylor is now looking for a reliable option that can satisfy their hunger.

name: Jordan
goal: Jordan hopes to guide the group towards a restaurant choice that not only satisfies everyone's cravings but also offers a memorable and unexpectedly delightful experience.
backstory: Jordan has lived in the city for years and loves exploring its hidden gems, especially when it comes to food - she's particularly fond of trying out new vegetarian spots. Having spent countless evenings wandering through the neighborhood with friends, Jordan has developed a keen sense of what makes a great dining experience. She still remembers that amazing Italian place they stumbled upon last summer, which sparked her interest in seeking out unique local eateries.

name: Casey
goal: Casey hopes to find a restaurant that can impress them with its authenticity and quality, rather than just relying on trendy marketing or popularity.
backstory: Casey has been writing restaurant reviews for the local paper and recently had a disappointing experience at a highly-recommended bistro, which made them skeptical of online reviews. They tend to prefer quieter, family-owned establishments that serve traditional cuisine. Casey's last memorable dinner was at a small Italian place that served exceptional pasta dishes.
